summary: Turn community input into a traceable NGO project concept. Practise consultation planning, Theory of Change and indicator validation. Explore the course.
lede: Participatory project design helps NGO staff shape feasible project concepts with the people affected by proposed interventions. Participants practise mapping stakeholders, choosing accessible consultation methods, and analysing community priorities with tools such as problem trees and participatory appraisal. They also turn community evidence into a Theory of Change and draft logframe, validate indicators, and document consent, feedback and how input informed decisions.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for NGO staff who plan projects with communities, partners or groups affected by proposed interventions.
modules: Core Humanitarian Standard and Safe Feedback
prerequisites: No prior formal project-design qualification is required. Familiarity with NGO projects or community engagement will help you connect the exercises to your work. Coding is not required.
